pesca_coleccion.cana.ayuda: Right-click to cast. Wait for the real bite (the bobber sinks hard) and right-click to strike: strike on a fake nibble and the fish gets scared.
pesca_coleccion.pesca.asustado: Too soon! The fish got scared
pesca_coleccion.pez.charalito.historia: Small enough to fit in a spoon. It shows up in any water and never runs out.
pesca_coleccion.pez.mojarra.historia: Everyone's first catch. It likes running water and the midday sun.
pesca_coleccion.pez.carpa.historia: Calm and greedy. It pulls hard for a while and then rests, as if thinking it over.
pesca_coleccion.pez.bagre.historia: It comes out at night to feed on the bottom. Its whiskers can feel even the bobber.
pesca_coleccion.pez.sardina.historia: It swims in huge schools that shine like a single coin underwater.
pesca_coleccion.pez.perca.historia: It hunts when the sun is low. Its orange fins give it away among the weeds.
pesca_coleccion.pez.lenguado.historia: It buries itself in the sand with only its eyes showing. Both are on the same side.
pesca_coleccion.pez.trucha_montana.histo: It lives in the icy water up high. It jumps to snatch insects out of the air.
pesca_coleccion.pez.trucha_arcoiris.hist: When it rains it rises to the surface and its pink stripe shines like a rainbow.
pesca_coleccion.pez.lucio.historia: It waits still among the plants and strikes all at once. Mind your fingers.
pesca_coleccion.pez.payaso.historia: It hides among anemones. It's tiny but won't be caught easily.
pesca_coleccion.pez.salmon_rojo.historia: It swims upriver at dawn, leaping waterfalls to return to where it was born.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_globo.historia: When scared it puffs up like a ball and the fight gets tight. Don't eat it!
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_luna.historia: Round as a plate and colored like a sunset. It loves the sun by the shore.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_espada.historia: The fastest in the open sea. It slices the water with its sword and turns in an instant.
pesca_coleccion.pez.anguila_cueva.histor: It has never seen the sun. It twists from side to side in the dark water of caves.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_linterna.histori: It rises from the deep at night with little lights on its body. Its arrows fade before they arrive.
pesca_coleccion.pez.koi_cerezo.historia: It only lives in ponds under cherry trees. They say it brings good luck to whoever sets it free.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pirana.historia: It fights fast and furious. Once it bites, the arrows come in bursts.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_fantasma.histori: Transparent as mist. It only appears on rainy nights and you can barely see it.
pesca_coleccion.pez.esturion.historia: It has swum the rivers since before villages existed. It's huge and never tires.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_volador.historia: With the lightning it leaps out and glides on wing-like fins. You have to catch it in the air.
pesca_coleccion.pez.patriarca.historia: A giant catfish with golden whiskers. They say it only bites on full-moon nights.
pesca_coleccion.pez.dragon_jade.historia: It shines like a gemstone. It only appears when storm and dawn reach the jungle together.
pesca_coleccion.pez.celacanto.historia: A fish from before the dinosaurs, with scales like glass. It rises from the abyss on moonless nights.
pesca_coleccion.libro.elige: Pick a fish to see its page. The ones you haven't caught have a hint about where to look.
pesca_coleccion.libro.reclamar_ayuda: You've discovered enough species: the rod is yours!
pesca_coleccion.libro.recibido: You got the Fishing Journal: your collection lives there.
pesca_coleccion.libro.ayuda: Your fish collection, the upgrades you earn with stars and the world records.
pesca_coleccion.mejora.mano_firme_1.que: The needle's green zone is wider.
pesca_coleccion.mejora.carrete_suave.que: Each arrow tires the fish 8% more.
pesca_coleccion.mejora.ojo_pescador.que: More time to hit the arrows.
pesca_coleccion.mejora.mano_firme_2.que: The green zone grows a bit more.
pesca_coleccion.mejora.carrete_maestro.q: Each arrow tires the fish 10% more.
pesca_coleccion.mejora.leyenda_agua.que: A bit of everything and more luck. You're a legend!
pesca_coleccion.cebo.como: Keep it in your off hand or inventory: it goes on the hook when you cast and the fish eats it when it bites (reel in early and you keep it).
pesca_coleccion.cebo.lombriz.como: Sometimes found when digging dirt or grass (more often in the rain). Also: dirt + rotten flesh.
pesca_coleccion.cebo.cebo_dulce.que: Bites come sooner and the fish fights calmer: it pulls less and tires sooner.
pesca_coleccion.cebo.cebo_dulce.como: Earthworm + honey or sweet berries + sugar.
pesca_coleccion.cebo.cebo_brillante.como: 2 earthworms + glowstone dust, glow berries or a glow ink sac.
pesca_coleccion.cebo.cebo_luna.que: Legendaries bite whatever the moon or weather (they still need their place and time).
pesca_coleccion.libro.ganada: You earned it! Click to get it
pesca_coleccion.nilo.llega: Well, well! It's been years since I saw someone fish with such spirit. I'm Nilo, a fisherman all my life. Mind if I build my dock right here? I've got jobs for you... and I pay well.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.llega_sin_muelle: Well, well! It's been years since I saw someone fish with such spirit. I'm Nilo, a fisherman all my life. There's no good spot for a dock, so I'll stay around here. Come see me anytime!
pesca_coleccion.nilo.explica: Bring me fish, land them without mistakes, discover new species... and I'll pay you in emeralds and bait. The better we know each other, the better things I'll give you. And one day I'll give you my old rod!
pesca_coleccion.nilo.hola_nuevo: Hello! I'm Nilo. I live here on my dock, fishing. I've got jobs for you, a little bait shop... and I'll buy your fish!
pesca_coleccion.nilo.cumplido: Nilo's job done! Go get your reward
pesca_coleccion.nilo.te_faltan: You need %s more fish for this job
pesca_coleccion.nilo.regalo.2: He gives you 4 sweet baits and starts selling glowing bait
pesca_coleccion.nilo.regalo.3: He gives you 3 glowing baits and starts selling moon lures
pesca_coleccion.nilo.regalo.4: He gives you his old rod!
pesca_coleccion.nilo.cambiar: Swap this job for another one (once a day)
pesca_coleccion.nilo.pide_nivel: Nilo sells it once you are %s
pesca_coleccion.nilo.sin_peces: You have no fish. Nilo pays well for big ones!
pesca_coleccion.nilo.no_pican: Nothing bites here right now. Try another time or weather.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.historia.0: I've fished these waters since I was a kid. My grandpa used to say every fish has its hour: whoever knows how to wait always eats.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.historia.1: Did you know the mojarra gets lively when the sun comes up? I get up before it does. Well... almost always.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.historia.2: Once I saw the River Patriarch. Golden whiskers, moon eyes. It took my rod, my cap and my pride. It only bites under a full moon.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.historia.3: Those who fish without mistakes listen to the water. It's not magic: it's patience. You're already listening, aren't you?
pesca_coleccion.nilo.historia.4: I have nothing left to teach you. Take my old rod: with it, fish can't fool you. Take care of it, it has more stories than I do.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.sin_encargos: Talk to Nilo to get jobs.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.e.grande: Bring me a %s of %s cm or more.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.e.rareza: Catch %s fish of %s rarity or better.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.e.perfecta: Land %s fish without a single mistake.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.e.nueva: Catch a species you've never caught.
pesca_coleccion.nilo.manana: Done! Nilo will have another job tomorrow.
pesca_coleccion.libro.cana_nilo: Nilo gives it to you once you're Legend of the dock.
pesca_coleccion.trofeo.vacio: Right-click with a fish to mount it on the plaque.
pesca_coleccion.trofeo.quitar: Sneak with an empty hand to take it down
pesca_coleccion.acuario.vacio: Right-click with a fish to release it here.
pesca_coleccion.acuario.sacar: Sneak with an empty hand to take the last one out
